description:
Hi, I’m an electrician based in France, and here I share practical, real-world electrical knowledge you can actually use.
I make step-by-step tutorials, explain how residential electrical systems work in simple terms, and talk about lighting, tools, safety, and electrical theory — from replacing a light switch to understanding how a home’s electrical system works as a whole.

This channel is for DIYers, beginners, apprentices, and anyone curious about electricity who wants clear explanations without unnecessary jargon.

Although I’m based in France, I focus on the core principles behind electrical wiring, showing how similar things really are from one country to another. Once you understand the basics, electricity makes sense almost anywhere — whether you’re in Europe, the US, Canada, or beyond.
